questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants. the transfer of pollen grains from anther to stigma is called:
questions.explanation: Pollination is pollen transfer to the stigma.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants. a typical angiosperm embryo sac is:
questions.explanation: The mature embryo sac is typically 7-celled and 8-nucleate.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Human Reproduction. in humans, fertilisation normally occurs in the:
questions.explanation: Fertilisation commonly occurs at the ampullary-isthmic junction.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Reproductive Health. copper-releasing IUDs primarily:

options.B: increase phagocytosis of sperms and reduce sperm motility

questions.explanation: Copper ions impair sperm motility and fertilising capacity; IUDs enhance local phagocytosis.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Principles of Inheritance. a test cross is performed by crossing an individual with:
questions.explanation: A homozygous recessive tester reveals the genotype of a dominant-phenotype individual.

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Molecular Basis of Inheritance. in DNA, adenine pairs with:

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Evolution. the wings of a butterfly and a bird are examples of:

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Human Health & Disease. antibodies are secreted mainly by:

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Microbes in Human Welfare. the microbe commonly used in curd formation is:
questions.explanation: Lactic acid bacteria such as Lactobacillus convert milk lactose to lactic acid.

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biotechnology: Principles & Processes. restriction endonucleases recognise:
questions.explanation: Restriction enzymes cut DNA at specific recognition sites.

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biotechnology & Its Applications. bt cotton is engineered to resist certain insect pests using genes from:
questions.explanation: Bt genes from Bacillus thuringiensis encode insecticidal proteins.

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Ecosystem. the pyramid of energy in an ecosystem is always:
questions.explanation: Energy decreases at successive trophic levels, so the energy pyramid is upright.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biodiversity & Conservation. an endemic species is one that:

options.A: occurs naturally only in a particular region

questions.explanation: Endemic species have a restricted natural geographical distribution.
